item.title: Baltic Dry Index Halts 7-Day Losing Run
item.description: The Baltic Exchange’s dry bulk index, which tracks rates for vessels transporting dry commodities, snapped a seven-day losing streak on Wednesday, rising about 4% to its highest since February 3rd at 1,958 points, driven by gains across the board.
